Corrigendum to Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) No 12/2014 of 8 January 2014 entering a name in the register of traditional specialities guaranteed [Salinātā rudzu rupjmaize (TSG)]

P.HT: (Official Journal of the European Union L 4 of 9 January 2014)

TI.P: entering a name in the register of traditional specialities guaranteed [Salinātā rudzu rupjmaize (TSG)]

GR.VISA.VISA: Having regard to the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union,

Having regard to Regulation (EU) No 1151/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 21 November 2012 on quality schemes for agricultural products and foodstuffs
OJ L 343, 14.12.2012, p. 1., and in particular Article 52(2) thereof,

NP.TXT:
Pursuant to Article 50(2)(b) of Regulation (EU) No 1151/2012, Latvia’s application to register the name Salinātā rudzu rupjmaize was published in the Official Journal of the European Union
OJ C 177, 22.6.2013, p. 12..
As no statement of opposition under Article 51 of Regulation (EU) No 1151/2012 has been received by the Commission, the name Salinātā rudzu rupjmaize should therefore be entered in the register,

ARTICLE.ALINEA: The name contained in the Annex to this Regulation is hereby entered in the register.
This Regulation shall enter into force on the twentieth day following that of its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union.

FINAL.P: This Regulation shall be binding in its entirety and directly applicable in all Member States.

CONTENTS.P: Agricultural products and foodstuffs listed in Annex I(I) to Regulation (EU) No 1151/2012:

TXT.HT: Confectionery, bread, pastry, cakes, biscuits and other baker's wares
